# AI For DJs Global
> AI tools, playbooks, and training that help DJs and event promoters run their business — built in Hawaii, serving DJs worldwide.

## Topics
- [AI DJ Tools](https://aifordjsglobal.com): Automation and assistants for working DJs.
- [DJ Playbook](https://aifordjsglobal.com/playbook): Repeatable systems for bookings and marketing.
- [ChatGPT for DJs](https://aifordjsglobal.com): Prompts and workflows for music businesses.
- [DJ Business Automation](https://aifordjsglobal.com): Remote coaching and setup.
